elaine: quick one — trying to make our JS SDK publish play nicely across Node (CJS), ESM, and Edge runtimes. local builds OK but examples/edge throws `TypeError: sdk.default is not a constructor`.
oscar: sounds like default vs named export mismatch. are your ESM bundles exporting default?

elaine: ESM build only has named exports (`export const createClient`) while CJS has `module.exports.default = createClient` for compat. The edge bundle (esbuild) expects default.

pete: two pragmatic paths: 1) make ESM bundle also export a default (rollup/tsup config), 2) add an explicit conditional subpath for edge/worker so edge consumers import an ESM-only entry: `import { createClient } from 'our-sdk/worker'` or `import SDK from 'our-sdk/worker'`.

li: if you add subpath, include types in that export: "./worker": { "import": "./dist/esm/worker.js", "types": "./dist/types/worker.d.ts" }. Otherwise TS might pick wrong declarations. Also consider `typesVersions` for older TS resolution.

elaine: thanks — another wrinkle: retry logic behaves differently in edge examples. second attempt loses body (stream drained). Node clones fine.
oscar: worker ReadableStreams often cannot be cloned the same way. Buffer body for retries or accept a request-factory: `retryFetch(() => ({ body: makeBody() }))`. Buffering ArrayBuffer is simplest cross-runtime.

pete: add a tiny helper `ensureRetryableBody(init)` in SDK that returns either the original init or a buffered copy. Document which callers must provide stream-safe bodies.

ci-bot: created ticket DEVEX-2022: "sdk: worker subpath + default export parity + retry-safe bodies" assigned to @elaine.

li: one more CI nit: Jest in our monorepo chokes on mixed ESM/CJS in node_modules. Solution: publish CJS under `dist/cjs` and add a `jest` field or a pretest step to transpile the ESM worker sample. Also include a smoke job that runs examples/edge on Vercel or Cloudflare in CI.

elaine: plan: 1) change build to emit ESM default + named, 2) add `./worker` conditional export with types, 3) implement `ensureRetryableBody` fallback, 4) add examples/edge and add CI smoke. I'll open a PR with a minimal repro.

oscar: sounds good. If we go the `./worker` subpath route, add a small README snippet recommending `import { createClient } from 'our-sdk/worker'` for edge runtimes to avoid bundler heuristics.

elaine: will do, thanks all.
